title: Computed by the compiler
description:
A `constexpr` function can be run by the compiler itself, before the program ever starts.

Write `constexpr int cube(int n)` returning `n * n * n`. The tests include a `static_assert`, which only compiles if `cube(3)` can be worked out at compile time.

starter.solution.cpp: // Write a constexpr function named cube.

hints: Put the keyword in front of the return type: `constexpr int cube(int n)`.
